issues.detail: The Greek 'ουδεις ημας εμισθωσατο' means 'none of us were hired' (passive). The Vietnamese translation 'Vì không ai mướn chúng tôi' translates to 'Because no one hired us,' which introduces a causal relationship ('Vì') not present in the Greek text.

The Greek 'ο εαν η δικαιον ληψεσθε' is a conditional structure meaning 'whatever is just/right you will receive.' The Vietnamese 'và điều gì phải lẽ, các ngươi sẽ nhận' uses 'và' (and), changing the logical structure from a condition to a sequence of events.
